name: postalform
title: PostalForm MCP Server
description: PostalForm MCP server for preparing mail drafts for hosted checkout or buyer-approved Stripe token payments, uploading PDFs, browsing forms, tracking order status, and creating agent-paid MPP/x402 machine orders.

authentication.note: No API key is required for the hosted MCP endpoint today. Draft tools support hosted checkout or complete_checkout with a buyer-approved Stripe token; machine payment tools require an MPP or x402 payment credential on retry.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT and OpenAI Responses API
chatgpt.setup: Configure a remote MCP server with server_url set to https://postalform.com/mcp. Prepare a draft for review, then use hosted checkout or complete_checkout if the client supplies a buyer-approved Stripe token.

gemini.label: Gemini SDKs and Gemini CLI
gemini.setup: Use a Gemini MCP-capable client with the streamable HTTP endpoint https://postalform.com/mcp. Gemini CLI can add it as an http transport server.

generic_mcp.label: Any MCP client that supports remote streamable HTTP
generic_mcp.setup: Add PostalForm with transport streamable-http and endpoint https://postalform.com/mcp. Read skill_url before sending real mail.

tools.name: postalform.create_letter_order_draft
tools.description: Create a hosted-checkout draft from letter text. Best default for chat clients.

tools.name: postalform.create_order_draft
tools.description: Create a hosted-checkout draft from a PDF upload or file URL.

tools.name: postalform.create_form_order_draft
tools.description: Create a hosted-checkout draft from a supported single-mailpiece workflow form payload.

tools.name: postalform.create_machine_order
tools.description: Create or pay a direct MPP/x402 machine order. Use only in authorized autonomous runtimes with spend controls.

tools.name: postalform.get_order_status
tools.description: Read draft/payment state, stored public mailing and carrier tracking status/events, and electronic return receipt availability without payment or mailing side effects.
